subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should this PR keep the runtime legacy fallback that treats no-pluginId, no-code, missing-source persisted diagnostics as stale during upgrade?
rationale: The explicit marker path follows prior maintainer direction, but the legacy fallback intentionally changes persisted SQLite registry behavior for upgraded users and needs owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
options.body: Require redacted latest-head legacy-upgrade proof, then accept the runtime rederive fallback as the bounded upgrade behavior.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Remove the runtime legacy fallback and handle pre-code orphan diagnostics through doctor or migration-owned repair instead.

options.title: Accept Source/Test Proof Only
options.body: Maintainers can waive the external proof gap and accept the current tests plus source inspection as sufficient for this upgrade path.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime Fallback After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted latest-head legacy-upgrade proof, then accept the runtime rederive fallback as the bounded upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He gave the explicit-marker direction on the predecessor and is the clearest recorded reviewer for this compatibility tradeoff.
